verdict.rationale: The pack has no documentation of retention policies, item or account deletion, or purge controls. Vault export, import, CLI vault management and self-hosting are adjacent capabilities and do not show that users can control retention or deletion. A single community remark mentions a support suggestion to 'delete account', but it is anecdotal and not first-party documentation of a deletion control.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can control data retention and deletion
